name: Fake ~Geinoujin wa Zen'in Usotsuki?~
original_name: フェイク ～芸能人は全員嘘つき？～
source: I gave up my dream of becoming an actress and settled as an average OL. However, my boyfriend cheated on me with an underground idol! Also, I managed to become scouted by an agency after many rejections. But the entertainment world hides dark secrets... It's up to the player to discover the end of this Cinderella story!
